tools.name: folk_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the user associated with the current Folk API key. Folk REST: GET /v1/users/me.

tools.name: folk_list_users
tools.description: List users in the Folk workspace (id, name, email) — useful for resolving owner ids. Folk REST: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: folk_list_people
tools.description: List/filter people (contacts). Supports cursor pagination and structured filters. Folk REST: GET /v1/people.

tools.name: folk_get_person
tools.description: Get a single person (contact) by id. Folk REST: GET /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: folk_list_companies
tools.description: List/filter companies. Supports cursor pagination and structured filters. Folk REST: GET /v1/companies.

tools.name: folk_get_company
tools.description: Get a single company by id. Folk REST: GET /v1/companies/{id}.

tools.name: folk_list_groups
tools.description: List groups in the Folk workspace (ids needed to place people/companies). Folk REST: GET /v1/groups.

tools.name: folk_list_notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally scoped to an entity or filtered by full text and creation date. Folk REST: GET /v1/notes.

tools.name: folk_get_note
tools.description: Get a single note by id. Folk REST: GET /v1/notes/{id}.

tools.name: folk_create_person
tools.description: Create a new person (contact). All fields are optional. Folk REST: POST /v1/people.

tools.name: folk_update_person
tools.description: Update fields on an existing person. Only provided fields are changed; list-valued fields (emails, phones, groups, companies, etc.) REPLACE the existing values. Folk REST: PATCH /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: folk_create_company
tools.description: Create a new company. `name` is required. Folk REST: POST /v1/companies.

tools.name: folk_update_company
tools.description: Update fields on an existing company. Only provided fields are changed; list-valued fields REPLACE the existing values. Folk REST: PATCH /v1/companies/{id}.

tools.name: folk_create_note
tools.description: Create a note attached to an entity (person/company). Folk REST: POST /v1/notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: folk_list_users, folk_update_person · Private data: folk_get_current_user, folk_list_people, folk_get_person, folk_create_person · Public sink: folk_list_users, folk_create_person, folk_create_company, folk_create_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: folk_list_users, folk_update_person · Private data: folk_get_current_user, folk_list_people, folk_get_person, folk_create_person · Public sink: folk_list_users, folk_create_person, folk_create_company, folk_create_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
